The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Specific Manufacturer Authorization F orm (MAF) specific to this bid shall be submitted on OEM letterhead, duly signed and sealed. Uploa d valid OEM-authorized business territory clearly covering the State of Kerala. (Common authorizat ion not allowed in this bid ) 6. Bidder shall submit GeM supply order for Desktop Computer with similar specification as per the bid, during the last 3 years. Proof of successful delivery certificate or CRAC must be submitted. 7. Upload documentary proof demonstrating compliance with the Buyer Added Additional Technic al Specifications, supported by the OEM Datasheet and OEM Brochure, with the relevant brochure page numbers clearly referenced for each specification. Failure to furnish the required documents may result in rejection of bid. 9. The bidder shall clearly identify the offered product model and provide sufficient documentary e vidence to establish compliance with the applicable technical requirements. 10. Bidder shall submit a self-declaration on company letterhead confirming that the firm has not been blacklisted/debarred by any Government/PSU organization during the last 5 years. 11. Bidder /OEM shall comply with Government of India Land Border Sharing regulations and subm it necessary declaration, wherever applicable. 12.
